answer: An attacker wants a trading agent to swallow a forged price history for lagoon oysters. He spins up hundreds of names, and each one connects to the agent to whisper the forgery. But the agent ignores whoever knocks; it dials a few peers it chose at random from months of contacts. One honest peer among them shows a different history. That delta freezes trading and flags every name that pushed the fake: hundreds of names burned by one true voice.
